```
00409| /// GET /ws/watch - WebSocket file watch endpoint
00410| pub async fn watch_ws(
00411|     State(state): State<AppState>,
00412|     Query(query): Query<WatchQuery>,
00413|     ws: WebSocketUpgrade,
00414| ) -> Result<Response, FileServerError> {
00415|     let path = resolve_and_verify_path(&state.root_dir, &query.path)?;
00416| 
00417|     if !path.exists() {
00418|         return Err(FileServerError::NotFound(query.path));
00419|     }
00420| 
00421|     if !path.is_dir() {
00422|         return Err(FileServerError::NotADirectory);
00423|     }
00424| 
00425|     let ext_filter = parse_extension_filter(&query.ext);
00426|     let state = state.clone();
00427| 
00428|     Ok(ws.on_upgrade(move |socket| watch_socket(socket, state, path, ext_filter)))
00429| }
00430| 
00431| async fn watch_socket(
00432|     mut socket: WebSocket,
00433|     state: AppState,
00434|     watch_path: PathBuf,
00435|     ext_filter: Option<HashSet<String>>,
00436| ) {
00437|     let (tx, mut rx) = mpsc::channel(128);
00438|     let mut watcher = match notify::recommended_watcher(move |res| {
00439|         if tx.blocking_send(res).is_err() {
00440|             debug!("File watch channel closed");
00441|         }
00442|     }) {
00443|         Ok(watcher) => watcher,
00444|         Err(err) => {
00445|             error!("Failed to initialize watcher: {:?}", err);
00446|             return;
00447|         }
00448|     };
00449| 
00450|     if let Err(err) = watcher.watch(&watch_path, RecursiveMode::Recursive) {
00451|         error!("Failed to watch path {}: {:?}", watch_path.display(), err);
00452|         return;
00453|     }
00454| 
00455|     let mut pending: HashMap<PathBuf, EventKind> = HashMap::new();
00456|     let mut deadline: Option<Instant> = None;
00457| 
00458|     loop {
00459|         tokio::select! {
00460|             incoming = rx.recv() => {
00461|                 match incoming {
00462|                     Some(Ok(event)) => {
00463|                         for path in event.paths {
00464|                             pending.insert(path, event.kind.clone());
00465|                         }
00466|                         deadline = Some(Instant::now() + WATCH_DEBOUNCE);
00467|                     }
00468|                     Some(Err(err)) => {
00469|                         warn!("Watcher error: {:?}", err);
00470|                     }
00471|                     None => break,
00472|                 }
00473|             }
00474|             _ = sleep_until(deadline.unwrap()) , if deadline.is_some() => {
00475|                 let mut batched = HashMap::new();
00476|                 std::mem::swap(&mut batched, &mut pending);
00477|                 deadline = None;
00478| 
00479|                 for (path, kind) in batched {
00480|                     if !path.starts_with(&state.root_dir) {
00481|                         continue;
00482|                     }
00483| 
00484|                     let is_dir = match fs::metadata(&path).await {
00485|                         Ok(metadata) => metadata.is_dir(),
00486|                         Err(_) => matches!(
00487|                             kind,
00488|                             EventKind::Create(CreateKind::Folder) | EventKind::Remove(RemoveKind::Folder)
00489|                         ),
00490|                     };
00491| 
00492|                     if !is_dir {
00493|                         if let Some(filter) = &ext_filter {
00494|                             let ext = path
00495|                                 .extension()
00496|                                 .and_then(|value| value.to_str())
00497|                                 .and_then(normalize_extension);
00498|                             if ext.as_ref().map_or(true, |value| !filter.contains(value)) {
00499|                                 continue;
00500|                             }
00501|                         }
00502|                     }
00503| 
00504|                     let Some(event_type) = event_label(&kind, is_dir) else {
00505|                         continue;
00506|                     };
00507| 
00508|                     let relative_path = get_relative_path(&state.root_dir, &path);
00509|                     if relative_path.is_empty() {
00510|                         continue;
00511|                     }
00512| 
00513|                     let payload = WatchEvent {
00514|                         event_type,
00515|                         path: relative_path,
00516|                         entry_type: if is_dir { "directory" } else { "file" },
00517|                     };
00518| 
00519|                     let Ok(data) = serde_json::to_string(&payload) else {
00520|                         continue;
00521|                     };
00522| 
00523|                     if socket.send(Message::Text(data)).await.is_err() {
00524|                         return;
00525|                     }
00526|                 }
00527|             }
00528|             message = socket.recv() => {
00529|                 match message {
00530|                     Some(Ok(Message::Close(_))) | None => break,
00531|                     Some(Ok(Message::Ping(payload))) => {
00532|                         let _ = socket.send(Message::Pong(payload)).await;
00533|                     }
00534|                     Some(Ok(_)) => {}
00535|                     Some(Err(err)) => {
00536|                         debug!("WebSocket receive error: {:?}", err);
00537|                         break;
00538|                     }
00539|                 }
00540|             }
00541|         }
00542|     }
00543| }
00544| 
00545| /// GET /tree - Get directory tree
00546| pub async fn get_tree(
00547|     State(state): State<AppState>,
00548|     Query(query): Query<TreeQuery>,
00549| ) -> Result<Json<Vec<FileNode>>, FileServerError> {
00550|     // Use resolve_and_verify_path for proper symlink handling
00551|     let path = resolve_and_verify_path(&state.root_dir, &query.path)?;
00552| 
00553|     if !path.exists() {
00554|         return Err(FileServerError::NotFound(query.path));
00555|     }
00556| 
00557|     if !path.is_dir() {
00558|         return Err(FileServerError::NotADirectory);
00559|     }
00560| 
00561|     let max_depth = query.depth.unwrap_or(state.config.max_depth);
00562| 
00563|     debug!(
00564|         "Getting tree for path: {}, mode: {:?}, depth: {}",
00565|         path.display(),
00566|         query.mode,
00567|         max_depth
00568|     );
00569| 
00570|     match query.mode {
00571|         ViewMode::Simple => {
00572|             // Flat list of office files only
00573|             let files = get_simple_file_list(&state, &path, max_depth)?;
00574|             Ok(Json(files))
00575|         }
00576|         ViewMode::Full => {
00577|             // Full directory tree
00578|             let state = state.clone();
00579|             let path = path.clone();
00580|             let show_hidden = query.show_hidden;
00581| 
00582|             let tree = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
00583|                 build_tree(&state, &path, max_depth, show_hidden)
00584|             })
00585|             .await
00586|             .map_err(|err| {
00587|                 FileServerError::Io(std::io::Error::new(
00588|                     std::io::ErrorKind::Other,
00589|                     err.to_string(),
00590|                 ))
00591|             })??;
00592|             Ok(Json(tree))
00593|         }
00594|     }
00595| }
00596| 
00597| /// Build full directory tree
00598| fn build_tree(
00599|     state: &AppState,
00600|     path: &Path,
00601|     max_depth: usize,
00602|     show_hidden: bool,
00603| ) -> Result<Vec<FileNode>, FileServerError> {
00604|     let mut nodes = Vec::new();
00605| 
00606|     let entries = std::fs::read_dir(path).map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
00607| 
00608|     for entry in entries {
00609|         let entry = entry.map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
00610|         let entry_path = entry.path();
00611|         let file_name = entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string();
00612| 
00613|         // Skip hidden files unless requested
00614|         if !show_hidden && file_name.starts_with('.') {
00615|             continue;
00616|         }
00617| 
00618|         // Skip hidden directories from config
00619|         if entry_path.is_dir() && state.config.is_hidden_dir(&file_name) {
00620|             continue;
00621|         }
00622| 
00623|         // Skip hidden extensions
00624|         if let Some(ext) = entry_path.extension() {
00625|             let ext_str = format!(".{}", ext.to_string_lossy());
00626|             if state.config.is_hidden_extension(&ext_str) {
00627|                 continue;
00628|             }
00629|         }
00630| 
00631|         let metadata = entry.metadata().map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
00632|         let relative_path = get_relative_path(&state.root_dir, &entry_path);
00633| 
00634|         let node = if entry_path.is_dir() {
00635|             let children = if max_depth > 1 {
00636|                 Some(build_tree(state, &entry_path, max_depth - 1, show_hidden)?)
00637|             } else {
00638|                 None
00639|             };
00640| 
00641|             FileNode {
00642|                 name: file_name,
00643|                 path: relative_path,
00644|                 node_type: FileType::Directory,
00645|                 size: None,
00646|                 modified: metadata.modified().ok().and_then(|t| {
00647|                     t.duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
00648|                         .ok()
00649|                         .map(|d| d.as_secs())
00650|                 }),
00651|                 children,
00652|             }
00653|         } else {
00654|             FileNode {
00655|                 name: file_name,
00656|                 path: relative_path,
00657|                 node_type: FileType::File,
00658|                 size: Some(metadata.len()),
00659|                 modified: metadata.modified().ok().and_then(|t| {
00660|                     t.duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
00661|                         .ok()
00662|                         .map(|d| d.as_secs())
00663|                 }),
00664|                 children: None,
00665|             }
00666|         };
00667| 
00668|         nodes.push(node);
00669|     }
00670| 
00671|     // Sort: directories first, then alphabetically
00672|     nodes.sort_by(|a, b| match (&a.node_type, &b.node_type) {
00673|         (FileType::Directory, FileType::File) => std::cmp::Ordering::Less,
00674|         (FileType::File, FileType::Directory) => std::cmp::Ordering::Greater,
00675|         _ => a.name.to_lowercase().cmp(&b.name.to_lowercase()),
00676|     });
00677| 
00678|     Ok(nodes)
00679| }
00680| 
00681| /// Get flat list of office files (simple mode)
00682| fn get_simple_file_list(
00683|     state: &AppState,
00684|     path: &Path,
00685|     max_depth: usize,
00686| ) -> Result<Vec<FileNode>, FileServerError> {
00687|     let mut files = Vec::new();
00688| 
00689|     for entry in WalkDir::new(path)
00690|         .max_depth(max_depth)
00691|         .into_iter()
00692|         .filter_entry(|e| {
00693|             let name = e.file_name().to_string_lossy();
00694|             // Skip hidden files and directories
00695|             if name.starts_with('.') {
00696|                 return false;
00697|             }
00698|             // Skip hidden directories from config
00699|             if e.file_type().is_dir() && state.config.is_hidden_dir(&name) {
00700|                 return false;
00701|             }
00702|             true
00703|         })
00704|     {
00705|         let entry = match entry {
00706|             Ok(e) => e,
00707|             Err(_) => continue,
00708|         };
00709| 
00710|         if !entry.file_type().is_file() {
00711|             continue;
00712|         }
00713| 
00714|         let entry_path = entry.path();
00715| 
00716|         // Check if it's an office file
00717|         if let Some(ext) = entry_path.extension() {
00718|             let ext_str = format!(".{}", ext.to_string_lossy());
00719|             if !state.config.is_office_file(&ext_str) {
00720|                 continue;
00721|             }
00722|         } else {
00723|             continue;
00724|         }
00725| 
00726|         let metadata = match entry.metadata() {
00727|             Ok(m) => m,
00728|             Err(_) => continue,
00729|         };
00730| 
00731|         let file_name = entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string();
00732|         let relative_path = get_relative_path(&state.root_dir, entry_path);
00733| 
00734|         files.push(FileNode {
00735|             name: file_name,
00736|             path: relative_path,
00737|             node_type: FileType::File,
00738|             size: Some(metadata.len()),
00739|             modified: metadata.modified().ok().and_then(|t| {
00740|                 t.duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
00741|                     .ok()
00742|                     .map(|d| d.as_secs())
00743|             }),
00744|             children: None,
00745|         });
00746|     }
00747| 
00748|     // Sort alphabetically
00749|     files.sort_by(|a, b| a.name.to_lowercase().cmp(&b.name.to_lowercase()));
00750| 
00751|     Ok(files)
00752| }
00753| 
00754| /// GET /file - Get file content
00755| ///
00756| /// Uses streaming to handle large files efficiently without loading them entirely into memory.
00757| /// If `highlight=true` is passed, returns syntax-highlighted HTML instead of raw content.
00758| pub async fn get_file(
00759|     State(state): State<AppState>,
00760|     Query(query): Query<FileQuery>,
00761| ) -> Result<Response, FileServerError> {
00762|     // Use resolve_and_verify_path for proper symlink handling
00763|     let path = resolve_and_verify_path(&state.root_dir, &query.path)?;
00764| 
00765|     if !path.exists() {
00766|         return Err(FileServerError::NotFound(query.path.clone()));
00767|     }
00768| 
00769|     if path.is_dir() {
00770|         return Err(FileServerError::NotAFile);
00771|     }
00772| 
00773|     let file_name = path
00774|         .file_name()
00775|         .map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().to_string())
00776|         .unwrap_or_default();
00777| 
00778|     // If syntax highlighting is requested, return highlighted HTML
00779|     if query.highlight {
00780|         debug!("Syntax highlighting file: {}", path.display());
00781|         
00782|         // Read file content (limit to 1MB for highlighting to prevent memory issues)
00783|         let metadata = fs::metadata(&path).await.map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
00784|         if metadata.len() > 1024 * 1024 {
00785|             return Err(FileServerError::FileTooLarge {
00786|                 size: metadata.len(),
00787|                 limit: 1024 * 1024,
00788|             });
00789|         }
00790|         
00791|         let content = fs::read_to_string(&path).await.map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
00792|         let path_clone = path.clone();
00793|         let theme_name = query.theme.unwrap_or_else(|| "base16-ocean.dark".to_string());
00794|         
00795|         // Do highlighting in blocking task since syntect is not async
00796|         let highlighted = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
00797|             highlight_code(&content, &path_clone, &theme_name)
00798|         })
00799|         .await
00800|         .map_err(|e| FileServerError::Io(std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::Other, e)))??;
00801|         
00802|         return Ok((
00803|             StatusCode::OK,
00804|             [
00805|                 (header::CONTENT_TYPE, "text/html; charset=utf-8".to_string()),
00806|                 (header::CONTENT_LENGTH, highlighted.len().to_string()),
00807|                 (header::CACHE_CONTROL, "public, max-age=60".to_string()),
00808|             ],
00809|             highlighted,
00810|         )
00811|             .into_response());
00812|     }
00813| 
00814|     debug!("Streaming file: {}", path.display());
00815| 
00816|     // Get file metadata for content-length
00817|     let metadata = fs::metadata(&path).await.map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
00818|     let file_size = metadata.len();
00819| 
00820|     // Open file for streaming
00821|     let file = fs::File::open(&path).await.map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
00822| 
00823|     // Create a stream from the file
00824|     let stream = ReaderStream::new(file);
00825|     let body = Body::from_stream(stream);
00826| 
00827|     let mime = mime_guess::from_path(&path)
00828|         .first_or_octet_stream()
00829|         .to_string();
00830| 
00831|     // Sanitize filename for Content-Disposition header
00832|     let safe_filename = file_name.replace('"', "'");
00833| 
00834|     Ok((
00835|         StatusCode::OK,
00836|         [
00837|             (header::CONTENT_TYPE, mime),
00838|             (header::CONTENT_LENGTH, file_size.to_string()),
00839|             (
00840|                 header::CONTENT_DISPOSITION,
00841|                 format!("inline; filename=\"{}\"", safe_filename),
00842|             ),
00843|         ],
00844|         body,
00845|     )
00846|         .into_response())
00847| }
00848| 
00849| /// Highlight code using syntect
00850| fn highlight_code(content: &str, path: &Path, theme_name: &str) -> Result<String, FileServerError> {
00851|     let syntax = path
00852|         .extension()
00853|         .and_then(|ext| SYNTAX_SET.find_syntax_by_extension(ext.to_str().unwrap_or("")))
00854|         .or_else(|| SYNTAX_SET.find_syntax_by_first_line(content))
00855|         .unwrap_or_else(|| SYNTAX_SET.find_syntax_plain_text());
00856| 
00857|     let theme = THEME_SET
00858|         .themes
00859|         .get(theme_name)
00860|         .or_else(|| THEME_SET.themes.get("base16-ocean.dark"))
00861|         .ok_or_else(|| {
00862|             FileServerError::Io(std::io::Error::new(
00863|                 std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound,
00864|                 "Theme not found",
00865|             ))
00866|         })?;
00867| 
00868|     let mut highlighter = syntect::easy::HighlightLines::new(syntax, theme);
00869|     let mut html_output = String::with_capacity(content.len() * 2);
00870|     
00871|     // Build HTML with line numbers using table layout for guaranteed alignment
00872|     html_output.push_str("<table class=\"highlighted-code\" style=\"font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%;\">");
00873|     html_output.push_str("<tbody>");
00874|     
00875|     for (i, line) in LinesWithEndings::from(content).enumerate() {
00876|         let regions = highlighter
00877|             .highlight_line(line, &SYNTAX_SET)
00878|             .map_err(|e| FileServerError::Io(std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::Other, e)))?;
00879|         let html_line = styled_line_to_highlighted_html(&regions[..], IncludeBackground::No)
00880|             .map_err(|e| FileServerError::Io(std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::Other, e)))?;
00881|         
00882|         html_output.push_str("<tr>");
00883|         // Line number cell
00884|         html_output.push_str(&format!(
00885|             "<td style=\"text-align: right; padding-right: 0.5em; min-width: 2.5em; color: #6b7280; user-select: none; vertical-align: top; white-space: nowrap;\">{}</td>",
00886|             i + 1
00887|         ));
00888|         // Code cell
00889|         html_output.push_str("<td style=\"white-space: pre; vertical-align: top;\">");
00890|         if html_line.trim().is_empty() {
00891|             html_output.push_str(" ");
00892|         } else {
00893|             // Trim the trailing newline from the highlighted line
00894|             html_output.push_str(html_line.trim_end_matches('\n'));
00895|         }
00896|         html_output.push_str("</td>");
00897|         html_output.push_str("</tr>");
00898|     }
00899|     
00900|     html_output.push_str("</tbody></table>");
00901|     
00902|     Ok(html_output)
00903| }
00904| 
00905| /// POST /file - Upload file
00906| pub async fn upload_file(
00907|     State(state): State<AppState>,
00908|     Query(query): Query<UploadQuery>,
00909|     mut multipart: Multipart,
00910| ) -> Result<Json<SuccessResponse>, FileServerError> {
00911|     // Use resolve_path for initial path building; deeper checks happen below.
00912|     let dest_path = resolve_path(&state.root_dir, &query.path)?;
00913| 
00914|     // Create parent directories if requested
00915|     if query.mkdir {
00916|         if let Some(parent) = dest_path.parent() {
00917|             if parent != state.root_dir {
00918|                 fs::create_dir_all(parent).await.map_err(|e| {
00919|                     error!("Failed to create directory: {}", e);
00920|                     FileServerError::CreateDirFailed(parent.display().to_string())
00921|                 })?;
00922|             }
00923|         }
00924|     }
00925| 
00926|     while let Some(mut field) = multipart.next_field().await.map_err(|e| {
00927|         error!("Multipart error: {}", e);
00928|         FileServerError::Io(std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, e))
00929|     })? {
00930|         // Get and SANITIZE the filename
00931|         let raw_filename = field
00932|             .file_name()
00933|             .map(|s| s.to_string())
00934|             .unwrap_or_else(|| "upload".to_string());
00935| 
00936|         let file_name = sanitize_filename(&raw_filename).ok_or_else(|| {
00937|             warn!("Rejected invalid filename: {:?}", raw_filename);
00938|             FileServerError::InvalidPath(format!("Invalid filename: {}", raw_filename))
00939|         })?;
00940| 
00941|         // Determine final path
00942|         let final_path = if dest_path.is_dir() || query.path.ends_with('/') {
00943|             // If destination is a directory, use the sanitized filename
00944|             let dir_path = if dest_path.exists() {
00945|                 dest_path.clone()
00946|             } else if query.mkdir {
00947|                 fs::create_dir_all(&dest_path).await.map_err(|_| {
00948|                     FileServerError::CreateDirFailed(dest_path.display().to_string())
00949|                 })?;
00950|                 dest_path.clone()
00951|             } else {
00952|                 return Err(FileServerError::NotFound(query.path.clone()));
00953|             };
00954|             dir_path.join(&file_name)
00955|         } else {
00956|             dest_path.clone()
00957|         };
00958| 
00959|         // Re-validate the final path is within root (belt-and-suspenders)
00960|         let canonical_root = state.root_dir.canonicalize().map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
00961|         if final_path.exists() {
00962|             let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(&final_path)
00963|                 .await
00964|                 .map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
00965|             if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
00966|                 warn!("Refusing to overwrite symlink: {:?}", final_path);
00967|                 return Err(FileServerError::PathTraversal);
00968|             }
00969|             if metadata.is_dir() {
00970|                 return Err(FileServerError::NotAFile);
00971|             }
00972|             let canonical_path = final_path.canonicalize().map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
00973|             if !canonical_path.starts_with(&canonical_root) {
00974|                 warn!("Final path resolved outside root: {:?}", final_path);
00975|                 return Err(FileServerError::PathTraversal);
00976|             }
00977|         } else if let Some(parent) = final_path.parent() {
00978|             if parent.exists() {
00979|                 let canonical_parent = parent.canonicalize().map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
00980|                 if !canonical_parent.starts_with(&canonical_root) {
00981|                     warn!("Final path parent outside root: {:?}", final_path);
00982|                     return Err(FileServerError::PathTraversal);
00983|                 }
00984|             }
00985|         }
00986| 
00987|         let parent_dir = final_path
00988|             .parent()
00989|             .ok_or_else(|| FileServerError::InvalidPath("Missing parent directory".to_string()))?;
00990|         let nonce = SystemTime::now()
00991|             .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
00992|             .map(|d| d.as_nanos())
00993|             .unwrap_or(0);
00994|         let temp_name = format!(".upload-{}-{}", file_name, nonce);
00995|         let temp_path = parent_dir.join(temp_name);
00996|         let mut temp_file = fs::File::create(&temp_path)
00997|             .await
00998|             .map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
00999| 
01000|         let mut total_size = 0u64;
01001|         while let Some(chunk) = field.chunk().await.map_err(|e| {
01002|             error!("Failed to read upload data: {}", e);
01003|             FileServerError::Io(std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, e))
01004|         })? {
01005|             total_size = total_size.saturating_add(chunk.len() as u64);
01006|             if total_size > state.config.max_upload_size {
01007|                 let _ = fs::remove_file(&temp_path).await;
01008|                 return Err(FileServerError::FileTooLarge {
01009|                     size: total_size,
01010|                     limit: state.config.max_upload_size,
01011|                 });
01012|             }
01013|             temp_file.write_all(&chunk).await.map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
01014|         }
01015|         temp_file.flush().await.map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
01016| 
01017|         info!(
01018|             "Uploading file: {} ({} bytes)",
01019|             final_path.display(),
01020|             total_size
01021|         );
01022| 
01023|         if final_path.exists() {
01024|             fs::remove_file(&final_path).await.map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
01025|         }
01026|         fs::rename(&temp_path, &final_path)
01027|             .await
01028|             .map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
01029| 
01030|         let relative_path = get_relative_path(&state.root_dir, &final_path);
01031| 
01032|         return Ok(Json(SuccessResponse {
01033|             success: true,
01034|             message: format!("File uploaded: {}", file_name),
01035|             path: Some(relative_path),
01036|         }));
01037|     }
01038| 
01039|     Err(FileServerError::Io(std::io::Error::new(
01040|         std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
01041|         "No file in upload",
01042|     )))
01043| }
01044| 
01045| /// DELETE /file - Delete file or directory
01046| pub async fn delete_file(
01047|     State(state): State<AppState>,
01048|     Query(query): Query<FileQuery>,
01049| ) -> Result<Json<SuccessResponse>, FileServerError> {
01050|     // Use resolve_and_verify_path for proper symlink handling
01051|     let path = resolve_and_verify_path(&state.root_dir, &query.path)?;
01052| 
01053|     if !path.exists() {
01054|         return Err(FileServerError::NotFound(query.path));
01055|     }
01056| 
01057|     // SECURITY: Prevent deletion of root directory
01058|     let canonical_root = state.root_dir.canonicalize().map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
01059|     let canonical_path = path.canonicalize().map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
01060| 
01061|     if canonical_path == canonical_root {
01062|         warn!("Attempted to delete root directory: {:?}", query.path);
01063|         return Err(FileServerError::InvalidPath(
01064|             "Cannot delete root directory".to_string(),
01065|         ));
01066|     }
01067| 
01068|     // Double-check path is still within root after canonicalization
01069|     if !canonical_path.starts_with(&canonical_root) {
01070|         warn!(
01071|             "Delete path escaped root after canonicalization: {:?}",
01072|             path
01073|         );
01074|         return Err(FileServerError::PathTraversal);
01075|     }
01076| 
01077|     info!("Deleting: {}", path.display());
01078| 
01079|     if path.is_dir() {
01080|         fs::remove_dir_all(&path)
01081|             .await
01082|             .map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
01083|     } else {
01084|         fs::remove_file(&path).await.map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
01085|     }
01086| 
01087|     Ok(Json(SuccessResponse {
01088|         success: true,
01089|         message: format!("Deleted: {}", query.path),
01090|         path: Some(query.path),
01091|     }))
01092| }

01094| /// PUT /file - Write file contents directly (for simple text/JSON files)
01095| pub async fn write_file(
01096|     State(state): State<AppState>,
01097|     Query(query): Query<UploadQuery>,
01098|     body: axum::body::Bytes,
01099| ) -> Result<Json<SuccessResponse>, FileServerError> {
01100|     let dest_path = resolve_path(&state.root_dir, &query.path)?;
01101| 
01102|     // Create parent directories if requested
01103|     if query.mkdir {
01104|         if let Some(parent) = dest_path.parent() {
01105|             if parent != state.root_dir && !parent.exists() {
01106|                 fs::create_dir_all(parent).await.map_err(|e| {
01107|                     error!("Failed to create directory: {}", e);
01108|                     FileServerError::CreateDirFailed(parent.display().to_string())
01109|                 })?;
01110|             }
01111|         }
01112|     }
01113| 
01114|     // SECURITY: Verify final path is within root
01115|     let canonical_root = state.root_dir.canonicalize().map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
01116|     if let Ok(canonical_dest) = dest_path.canonicalize() {
01117|         if !canonical_dest.starts_with(&canonical_root) {
01118|             warn!("Write path escaped root: {:?}", dest_path);
01119|             return Err(FileServerError::PathTraversal);
01120|         }
01121|     } else if let Some(parent) = dest_path.parent() {
01122|         // File doesn't exist yet, check parent
01123|         if let Ok(canonical_parent) = parent.canonicalize() {
01124|             if !canonical_parent.starts_with(&canonical_root) {
01125|                 warn!("Write path parent escaped root: {:?}", parent);
01126|                 return Err(FileServerError::PathTraversal);
01127|             }
01128|         }
01129|     }
01130| 
01131|     info!("Writing file: {} ({} bytes)", dest_path.display(), body.len());
01132| 
01133|     // Write the file
01134|     let mut file = fs::File::create(&dest_path).await.map_err(|e| {
01135|         error!("Failed to create file: {}", e);
01136|         FileServerError::Io(e)
01137|     })?;
01138| 
01139|     file.write_all(&body).await.map_err(|e| {
01140|         error!("Failed to write file: {}", e);
01141|         FileServerError::Io(e)
01142|     })?;
01143| 
01144|     Ok(Json(SuccessResponse {
01145|         success: true,
01146|         message: format!("Written: {} ({} bytes)", query.path, body.len()),
01147|         path: Some(query.path),
01148|     }))
01149| }

01180| /// GET /download - Download a single file or directory as zip
01181| ///
01182| /// For files: returns the file with Content-Disposition: attachment
01183| /// For directories: returns a zip archive of the directory
01184| pub async fn download(
01185|     State(state): State<AppState>,
01186|     Query(query): Query<DownloadQuery>,
01187| ) -> Result<Response, FileServerError> {
01188|     let path = resolve_and_verify_path(&state.root_dir, &query.path)?;
01189| 
01190|     if !path.exists() {
01191|         return Err(FileServerError::NotFound(query.path));
01192|     }
01193| 
01194|     let file_name = path
01195|         .file_name()
01196|         .map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().to_string())
01197|         .unwrap_or_else(|| "download".to_string());
01198| 
01199|     if path.is_file() {
01200|         // Single file download
01201|         debug!("Downloading file: {}", path.display());
01202| 
01203|         let metadata = fs::metadata(&path).await.map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
01204|         let file_size = metadata.len();
01205|         let file = fs::File::open(&path).await.map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
01206|         let stream = ReaderStream::new(file);
01207|         let body = Body::from_stream(stream);
01208| 
01209|         let mime = mime_guess::from_path(&path)
01210|             .first_or_octet_stream()
01211|             .to_string();
01212| 
01213|         let safe_filename = file_name.replace('"', "'");
01214| 
01215|         Ok((
01216|             StatusCode::OK,
01217|             [
01218|                 (header::CONTENT_TYPE, mime),
01219|                 (header::CONTENT_LENGTH, file_size.to_string()),
01220|                 (
01221|                     header::CONTENT_DISPOSITION,
01222|                     format!("attachment; filename=\"{}\"", safe_filename),
01223|                 ),
01224|             ],
01225|             body,
01226|         )
01227|             .into_response())
01228|     } else {
01229|         // Directory download - create zip
01230|         debug!("Downloading directory as zip: {}", path.display());
01231| 
01232|         let zip_name = format!("{}.zip", file_name);
01233|         let safe_zip_name = zip_name.replace('"', "'");
01234| 
01235|         // Create zip in memory
01236|         let zip_data = create_zip_from_paths(&state.root_dir, &[path.clone()])?;
01237| 
01238|         Ok((
01239|             StatusCode::OK,
01240|             [
01241|                 (header::CONTENT_TYPE, "application/zip".to_string()),
01242|                 (header::CONTENT_LENGTH, zip_data.len().to_string()),
01243|                 (
01244|                     header::CONTENT_DISPOSITION,
01245|                     format!("attachment; filename=\"{}\"", safe_zip_name),
01246|                 ),
01247|             ],
01248|             zip_data,
01249|         )
01250|             .into_response())
01251|     }
01252| }

01254| /// GET /download-zip - Download multiple files/directories as a single zip
01255| pub async fn download_zip(
01256|     State(state): State<AppState>,
01257|     Query(query): Query<DownloadZipQuery>,
01258| ) -> Result<Response, FileServerError> {
01259|     // Parse comma-separated paths
01260|     let paths: Vec<&str> = query.paths.split(',').map(|s| s.trim()).collect();
01261| 
01262|     if paths.is_empty() {
01263|         return Err(FileServerError::InvalidPath(
01264|             "No paths provided".to_string(),
01265|         ));
01266|     }
01267| 
01268|     // Resolve and verify all paths
01269|     let mut resolved_paths = Vec::new();
01270|     for path_str in &paths {
01271|         let resolved = resolve_and_verify_path(&state.root_dir, path_str)?;
01272|         if !resolved.exists() {
01273|             return Err(FileServerError::NotFound(path_str.to_string()));
01274|         }
01275|         resolved_paths.push(resolved);
01276|     }
01277| 
01278|     debug!("Downloading {} items as zip", resolved_paths.len());
01279| 
01280|     // Create zip
01281|     let zip_data = create_zip_from_paths(&state.root_dir, &resolved_paths)?;
01282| 
01283|     let zip_name = query.name.unwrap_or_else(|| "download.zip".to_string());
01284|     let safe_zip_name = zip_name.replace('"', "'");
01285| 
01286|     Ok((
01287|         StatusCode::OK,
01288|         [
01289|             (header::CONTENT_TYPE, "application/zip".to_string()),
01290|             (header::CONTENT_LENGTH, zip_data.len().to_string()),
01291|             (
01292|                 header::CONTENT_DISPOSITION,
01293|                 format!("attachment; filename=\"{}\"", safe_zip_name),
01294|             ),
01295|         ],
01296|         zip_data,
01297|     )
01298|         .into_response())
01299| }
01300| 
01301| /// Create a zip archive from a list of paths (files or directories)
01302| fn create_zip_from_paths(root: &Path, paths: &[PathBuf]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, FileServerError> {
01303|     let buffer = Cursor::new(Vec::new());
01304|     let mut zip = ZipWriter::new(buffer);
01305|     let options = SimpleFileOptions::default()
01306|         .compression_method(zip::CompressionMethod::Deflated)
01307|         .unix_permissions(0o644);
01308| 
01309|     for path in paths {
01310|         if path.is_file() {
01311|             // Add single file
01312|             let relative = get_relative_path(root, path);
01313|             let file_name = if relative.is_empty() {
01314|                 path.file_name()
01315|                     .map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().to_string())
01316|                     .unwrap_or_else(|| "file".to_string())
01317|             } else {
01318|                 relative
01319|             };
01320| 
01321|             let data = std::fs::read(path).map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
01322|             zip.start_file(&file_name, options).map_err(|e| {
01323|                 FileServerError::Io(std::io::Error::new(
01324|                     std::io::ErrorKind::Other,
01325|                     e.to_string(),
01326|                 ))
01327|             })?;
01328|             zip.write_all(&data).map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
01329|         } else if path.is_dir() {
01330|             // Add directory recursively
01331|             add_directory_to_zip(&mut zip, root, path, options)?;
01332|         }
01333|     }
01334| 
01335|     let result = zip.finish().map_err(|e| {
01336|         FileServerError::Io(std::io::Error::new(
01337|             std::io::ErrorKind::Other,
01338|             e.to_string(),
01339|         ))
01340|     })?;
01341| 
01342|     Ok(result.into_inner())
01343| }
01344| 
01345| /// Recursively add a directory to a zip archive
01346| fn add_directory_to_zip(
01347|     zip: &mut ZipWriter<Cursor<Vec<u8>>>,
01348|     root: &Path,
01349|     dir: &Path,
01350|     options: SimpleFileOptions,
01351| ) -> Result<(), FileServerError> {
01352|     for entry in WalkDir::new(dir).into_iter().filter_map(|e| e.ok()) {
01353|         let entry_path = entry.path();
01354|         let relative = get_relative_path(root, entry_path);
01355| 
01356|         if entry_path.is_file() {
01357|             let data = std::fs::read(entry_path).map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
01358|             zip.start_file(&relative, options).map_err(|e| {
01359|                 FileServerError::Io(std::io::Error::new(
01360|                     std::io::ErrorKind::Other,
01361|                     e.to_string(),
01362|                 ))
01363|             })?;
01364|             zip.write_all(&data).map_err(FileServerError::Io)?;
01365|         } else if entry_path.is_dir() && entry_path != dir {
01366|             // Add directory entry (trailing slash)
01367|             let dir_name = format!("{}/", relative);
01368|             zip.add_directory(&dir_name, options).map_err(|e| {
01369|                 FileServerError::Io(std::io::Error::new(
01370|                     std::io::ErrorKind::Other,
01371|                     e.to_string(),
01372|                 ))
01373|             })?;
01374|         }
01375|     }
01376| 
01377|     Ok(())
01378| }
```

```
00432| function PermissionsSection({ permission, onChange, modified }: PermissionsSectionProps) {
00433| 	// Determine if we have a global permission or per-tool permissions
00434| 	const isGlobalPermission = typeof permission === "string";
00435| 	const globalValue: PermissionAction | "__none__" = isGlobalPermission ? permission : "__none__";
00436| 	const toolPermissions: Record<string, PermissionAction> = 
00437| 		permission && typeof permission === "object" 
00438| 			? Object.fromEntries(
00439| 					Object.entries(permission).map(([k, v]) => [k, typeof v === "string" ? v : "ask"])
00440| 				)
00441| 			: {};
00442| 
00443| 	// Handle global permission change
00444| 	const handleGlobalChange = (value: string) => {
00445| 		if (value === "__none__") {
00446| 			// Clear global, keep any tool-specific permissions or clear all
00447| 			onChange(undefined);
00448| 		} else {
00449| 			// Set global permission (removes all tool-specific)
00450| 			onChange(value as PermissionAction);
00451| 		}
00452| 	};
00453| 
00454| 	// Handle individual tool permission change
00455| 	const handleToolChange = (toolId: string, value: string) => {
00456| 		// Start with existing object permissions or empty object
00457| 		const currentObj: Record<string, PermissionAction> = 
00458| 			permission && typeof permission === "object" 
00459| 				? { ...toolPermissions }
00460| 				: {};
00461| 
00462| 		if (value === "__none__") {
00463| 			// Remove this tool's permission
00464| 			delete currentObj[toolId];
00465| 			// If no permissions left, clear the whole thing
00466| 			if (Object.keys(currentObj).length === 0) {
00467| 				onChange(undefined);
00468| 			} else {
00469| 				onChange(currentObj);
00470| 			}
00471| 		} else {
00472| 			// Set or update this tool's permission
00473| 			currentObj[toolId] = value as PermissionAction;
00474| 			onChange(currentObj);
00475| 		}
00476| 	};
00477| 
00478| 	// Get the effective permission for a tool
00479| 	const getToolPermission = (toolId: string): PermissionAction | "__none__" => {
00480| 		if (isGlobalPermission) {
00481| 			// Global permission applies to all tools
00482| 			return permission;
00483| 		}
00484| 		return toolPermissions[toolId] || "__none__";
00485| 	};
00486| 
00487| 	return (
00488| 		<div className="space-y-3 p-3 bg-muted/30 border border-border/50 rounded-md">

00490| 				<Label className="text-xs font-medium">Permissions</Label>
00491| 				{modified && (

00493| 						modified
00494| 					</Badge>
00495| 				)}
00496| 			</div>

00498| 				Control which tools require confirmation before use
00499| 			</p>
00500|

00502| 			<div className="flex items-center justify-between py-1.5 border-b border-border/50">
00503| 				<div className="flex flex-col">
00504| 					<span className="text-xs font-medium">All Tools</span>
00505| 					<span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Set permission for all tools</span>
00506| 				</div>
00507| 				<Select value={globalValue} onValueChange={handleGlobalChange}>
00508| 					<SelectTrigger className="h-7 w-24 text-xs bg-background">
00509| 						<SelectValue />
00510| 					</SelectTrigger>
00511| 					<SelectContent>
00512| 						<SelectItem value="__none__">Per-tool</SelectItem>
00513| 						<SelectItem value="allow">Allow</SelectItem>
00514| 						<SelectItem value="ask">Ask</SelectItem>
00515| 						<SelectItem value="deny">Deny</SelectItem>
```

## Message 341: Assistant
**Timestamp:** 08:17:03

OpenCode reads its config file at startup, so **changes require restarting the opencode service** to take effect.

In Octo's context, this means:
- For a running session, you'd need to stop and start the session again
- The config is read when the opencode process spawns, not hot-reloaded

If you want immediate config changes without restart, that would require OpenCode itself to support config hot-reloading (watching the file for changes), which it currently doesn't do.

Would you like me to add a note/hint in the Agent Settings UI to inform users that changes require a session restart?

#### ✅ edit - "frontend/lib/control-plane-client.ts"

```
{
      "filePath": "/home/wismut/byteowlz/octo/frontend/lib/control-plane-client.ts",
```
```
      "oldString": "/**\n * Restart a workspace session by stopping and resuming it.\n * This is useful for applying config changes that require a restart.\n */\nexport async function restartWorkspaceSession(\n\tsessionId: string,\n): Promise<WorkspaceSession> {\n\tawait stopWorkspaceSession(sessionId);\n\treturn resumeWorkspaceSession(sessionId);\n}",
      "newString": "/**\n * Restart a workspace session by stopping and resuming it.\n * This is useful for applying config changes that require a restart.\n * Waits for the session to be fully running before returning.\n */\nexport async function restartWorkspaceSession(\n\tsessionId: string,\n): Promise<WorkspaceSession> {\n\tawait stopWorkspaceSession(sessionId);\n\tconst session = await resumeWorkspaceSession(sessionId);\n\t\n\t// Wait for session to be fully running (poll every 500ms, max 30s)\n\tconst maxAttempts = 60;\n\tfor (let i = 0; i < maxAttempts; i++) {\n\t\tconst current = await getWorkspaceSession(sessionId);\n\t\tif (current?.status === \"running\") {\n\t\t\treturn current;\n\t\t}\n\t\tif (current?.status === \"failed\" || current?.status === \"error\") {\n\t\t\tthrow new Error(`Session failed to restart: ${current.status}`);\n\t\t}\n\t\tawait new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 500));\n\t}\n\t\n\t// Return what we have even if not fully running yet\n\treturn session;\n}"
    }
```

Both builds are successful. Now you need to restart the octo backend for the changes to take effect. The key improvements:

**Backend changes (`session/service.rs`):**
1. Wrapped the resume logic in `resume_session_inner` 
2. Added error handling that marks the session as "failed" when any part of resume fails
3. This ensures sessions don't get stuck in "starting" state

**Frontend changes (`control-plane-client.ts`):**
1. Improved error message to include the actual `error_message` from the failed session

To apply the backend changes, you'll need to restart the octo server:
```bash
# Stop and restart octo serve
```

## Message 462: Assistant
**Timestamp:** 08:36:29

All done. Here's a summary of what was fixed and tested:

## Summary

### Backend Changes (`session/service.rs`)

1. **Refactored `resume_session_with_readiness`** to properly handle errors:
   - Split the function into an outer wrapper and `resume_session_inner`
   - The wrapper catches any error from the inner function and marks the session as "failed"
   - This ensures sessions never get stuck in "starting" state

2. **Fixed `session.clone()` calls** where the session is now a mutable reference in the inner function

3. **Fixed unused `mut` warning** in `proxy.rs`

### New Tests Added

Added 5 new tests for session resume error handling:

1. **`test_resume_session_marks_failed_on_container_start_error`** - Verifies session is marked failed when container start fails
2. **`test_resume_session_marks_failed_on_readiness_timeout`** - Verifies session is marked failed when services don't become ready
3. **`test_resume_session_not_stopped_returns_error`** - Verifies error when trying to resume a non-stopped session
4. **`test_resume_session_not_found_returns_error`** - Verifies error when session doesn't exist
5. **`test_resume_session_success`** - Verifies successful resume marks session as running

### Test Results
- All 15 session service tests pass
- All 587 total tests pass (282 + 270 + 35 = 587)
- No new warnings introduced

### Project Overview
We're working on **Octo**, a frontend React/TypeScript application that provides a web UI for OpenCode (an AI coding assistant). The frontend communicates with a control-plane backend (Rust/Axum) and a fileserver for file operations.

---

### What We Completed

#### 1. Agent Settings Sidebar Feature

- Added permissions configuration UI for tool permissions

- Added a "Restart" button to Agent Settings that restarts the OpenCode session to apply config changes
- The restart waits for the agent to finish if it's busy (won't interrupt a running turn)
- Added info banner explaining that config changes require restart

#### 3. Fixed Session Resume Error Handling (Backend)
Sessions were getting stuck in "starting" state when resume failed. Fixed by:

**File: `backend/src/session/service.rs`**

- This ensures sessions never get stuck in "starting" state

#### 5. Fixed Config File

---

### Current Issue - CRITICAL BUG

**The readable ID generation system has a fundamental flaw causing "drift":**

The user sees a session labeled "foxy-geek" in the UI header, but this session **doesn't exist in the database**. The agent shows "Agent working..." but doesn't respond because it's connected to a non-existent/orphaned session.

**Root cause investigation:**
1. "foxy-geek" is a valid generated alias (foxy=adjective, geek=noun from `backend/src/wordlist/mod.rs`)
2. But `SELECT * FROM sessions WHERE readable_id = 'foxy-geek'` returns nothing
3. The frontend is generating/displaying this ID from somewhere other than the backend

**Discovery:** The frontend has its own `generateReadableId()` function in `frontend/lib/session-utils.ts` (line 1823) that generates readable IDs **client-side** from OpenCode session IDs, completely independent of the backend's database!

---

### What Needs To Be Done Next

#### 1. Investigate the Frontend's `generateReadableId` Function
Read `frontend/lib/session-utils.ts` around line 1823 to understand:
- How it generates IDs
- Whether it's deterministic (same input = same output)
- Why it's generating IDs client-side instead of using backend's `readable_id`

#### 2. Fix the Drift Problem
Options to consider:
1. **Remove frontend ID generation** - Always use backend's `readable_id` field
2. **Make frontend generation deterministic** - Use a hash of session ID to generate consistent aliases
3. **Sync IDs** - Store the generated ID in backend when first displayed

#### 3. Ensure Single Source of Truth
The readable ID should be:
- Generated once (in backend) when session is created
- Stored in database
- Returned to frontend via API
- Never regenerated

---

```
00165| /// Generate a random human-readable ID in adjective-noun format
00166| /// Example: "cold-lamp", "blue-frog"
00167| pub fn generate_readable_id() -> String {
00168|     let mut rng = rand::rng();
00169|     let adj_idx = rng.random_range(0..ADJECTIVES.len());
00170|     let noun_idx = rng.random_range(0..NOUNS.len());
00171|     format!("{}-{}", ADJECTIVES[adj_idx], NOUNS[noun_idx])
00172| }
00173| 
00174| /// Generate a readable ID with collision avoidance
00175| /// Takes a closure that checks if the ID already exists
00176| #[allow(dead_code)]
00177| pub fn generate_unique_readable_id<F>(exists: F) -> String
00178| where
00179|     F: Fn(&str) -> bool,
00180| {
00181|     let mut attempts = 0;
00182|     loop {
00183|         let id = generate_readable_id();
00184|         if !exists(&id) {
00185|             return id;
00186|         }
00187|         attempts += 1;
00188|         // After many attempts, add a random suffix to guarantee uniqueness
00189|         if attempts > 100 {
00190|             let mut rng = rand::rng();
00191|             let suffix: u16 = rng.random_range(0..1000);
00192|             return format!("{}-{}", generate_readable_id(), suffix);
00193|         }
00194|     }
00195| }
00196|

00203|         let id = generate_readable_id();
00204|         assert!(id.contains('-'), "ID should contain a hyphen");
00205|         let parts: Vec<&str> = id.split('-').collect();
00206|         assert_eq!(parts.len(), 2, "ID should have exactly two parts");
00207|     }
```

## Message 577: Assistant
**Timestamp:** 09:12:34

I see now. OpenCode has its own chat sessions (`ses_xxx.json` files), and they're completely separate from Octo's "workspace sessions" in the database.

So the intent is:
- **OpenCode chat sessions** (`ses_xxx`) = individual conversations
- **Each chat session should have its own readable ID** for easy identification
- The frontend generates these deterministically from the session ID

The problem is that `generateReadableId` in the frontend uses **different word lists** than the backend, causing the drift.

Let me revert my changes and fix this properly - by making the frontend's word lists match the backend's:

Now let me understand the real issue. The frontend generates readable IDs deterministically from OpenCode session IDs. The problem is that the **word lists are different** between frontend and backend, so:
- Frontend: `generateReadableId("ses_abc")` → "foxy-geek" (using frontend word lists)
- Backend: `generate_readable_id()` → random ID like "oily-name" (using backend word lists)

```
00469|         &self,

00501|                     // Check for overlap between [port, range_end) and [agent_base, their_agent_end)
00502|                     port < their_agent_end && range_end > *agent_base
00503|                 } else {
00504|                     false
00505|                 };
00506| 
00507|                 session_ports_conflict || agent_range_conflict

00509| 
00510|             if !conflicts {
00511|                 return Ok(port);
00512|             }
00513|
```

## Message 645: Assistant
**Timestamp:** 09:20:35

Done! Here's a summary of the changes:

## Summary

**The problem:** There were two separate readable ID systems causing confusion:
1. **Backend (Octo)**: Random IDs for "workspace sessions" stored in `sessions.db`
2. **Frontend**: Deterministic hash-based IDs for OpenCode chat sessions (generated on-the-fly)

**The fix:** Removed the backend's readable_id system entirely. Now there's only **one source of truth** - the frontend's deterministic `generateReadableId()` function that computes readable IDs from OpenCode chat session IDs.

### Files Changed

**Backend:**
- `backend/src/session/models.rs` - Removed `readable_id` field from `Session` struct
- `backend/src/session/repository.rs` - Removed `readable_id` from SQL queries, removed `get_by_readable_id()` and `readable_id_exists()` functions
- `backend/src/session/service.rs` - Removed `generate_unique_readable_id()` and `get_session_by_alias()` functions, removed wordlist import
- `backend/src/api/handlers.rs` - Removed alias lookup fallback in `get_session`
- `backend/src/ctl/main.rs` - Removed readable_id from CLI output
- `backend/src/wordlist/mod.rs` - **Deleted** (no longer needed)
- `backend/src/main.rs` & `backend/src/lib.rs` - Removed wordlist module declarations

**Frontend:**
- `frontend/lib/control-plane-client.ts` - Removed `readable_id` from `WorkspaceSession` type
- `frontend/apps/personas/index.tsx` - Updated to use `session.id.slice(0, 8)` instead of `readable_id`

### How it works now

The frontend's `generateReadableId(sessionId)` in `frontend/lib/session-utils.ts` is the single source of truth:
- Takes an OpenCode session ID (e.g., `ses_abc123`)
- Uses a deterministic hash to pick words from the word lists
- Always returns the same readable ID for the same input
- No database storage needed - it's a pure function

The frontend always has the session objects available and generates readable IDs for display. But if someone wants to **search by readable ID** or **copy a readable ID and use it to find a session**, that won't work.

**Options to fix this:**

1. **Build a reverse lookup at runtime** - When loading sessions, build a `Map<readableId, sessionId>` in memory
2. **Store the mapping** - Save `readable_id` alongside sessions in OpenCode's storage
3. **Search by generating** - When searching, generate readable IDs for all sessions and match

Which approach do you want? Option 1 is simplest - just maintain a map in the frontend context.

## Message 678: Assistant
**Timestamp:** 09:26:08

**438,246 unique combinations.**

That's enough for most use cases, but if you're generating a lot of sessions, collisions become likely due to the birthday problem:
- 50% collision chance at ~780 sessions
- At 1000 sessions, ~68% chance of at least one collision

Do you want more words? We could:
1. Add more adjectives/nouns
2. Use 3 words (adjective-adjective-noun or adjective-noun-noun)
3. Add a short numeric suffix when collisions occur

## Message 689: Assistant

Done. Here's the summary:

## Summary

**Single source of truth for readable IDs:**

- **Backend generates** the `readable_id` when serving `ChatSession` objects via `/api/chat-history`
- **Deterministic**: Same session ID always produces same readable ID (hash-based)
- **Format**: `adjective-noun-noun` (e.g., "cold-lamp-bird")
- **Combinations**: 291 × 1506 × 1506 = **~660 million unique IDs**

**Files changed:**

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `backend/src/wordlist/mod.rs` | Changed from random to deterministic `readable_id_from_session_id()`, 3-word format |
| `backend/src/history/mod.rs` | Added `readable_id` field to `ChatSession`, generates it when reading sessions |
| `frontend/lib/session-utils.ts` | Updated `generateReadableId()` to 3-word format |
| `frontend/lib/control-plane-client.ts` | Added `readable_id: string` to `ChatSession` type |

**The flow:**
1. Backend reads OpenCode session files from disk
2. Backend generates `readable_id` deterministically from session ID
3. Frontend receives `readable_id` in API response
4. Frontend can also compute it locally if needed (same algorithm)

## Message 690: Assistant
**Timestamp:** 09:31:59

The collision chance depends on total sessions across all users, not per-user.

With **660 million combinations** and the birthday problem formula:

| Total Sessions | Collision Probability |
|----------------|----------------------|
| 1,000 | ~0.00008% |
| 10,000 | ~0.008% |
| 100,000 | ~0.75% |
| 500,000 | ~17% |
| 1,000,000 | ~53% |

So for a multi-user deployment:
- **100 users × 1,000 sessions each** = 100K sessions → **<1% collision chance**
- **1,000 users × 1,000 sessions each** = 1M sessions → **~53% collision chance** (at least one collision somewhere)

Collisions aren't catastrophic since the actual session ID (`ses_xxx`) is still unique - two sessions would just have the same human-readable name. But it could be confusing.

**Options if you want zero collisions:**

1. **Add 4th word**: 660M × 1506 = **~994 billion** combinations
2. **Add short hash suffix**: `cold-lamp-bird-7f3` 
3. **Scope by user**: Include user ID in the hash so collisions can only happen within same user's sessions

Which approach do you prefer?

```
cold-lamp-bird | alice | /home/alice/myapp | "Add login page" | 2 hours ago
```
